author: Andretti666
quote: They striped away everything that made gta, gta… pointless game where the couple is desperate for money yet there’s no real use cases for it. Can buy cars gotta steal and register qualifying cars. Pure QTE bs. Game holds your hands through the end. I won’t add graphics and gameplay cause at LEAST the minimum they gave us was that which was expected. Story is dull and clearly written by women. With this perspective that when men hang out they share the same bed and strip down too their underwear… The characters are super boring. Etc etc. Gun holding is limited. So many things to complain about….. it use to take me days to play previous gtas but by day to I’m already 64% done with about 15 hrs on gameplay.. this game is truly not challenging and you really don’t need to think to complete this cuck simulator
